sources.title: As Epstein questions linger, Trump falls back into familiar habit: lashing out at female reporters
Trump faces criticism for referring to female Bloomberg reporter as ‘piggy’

supported_event_claim: The Guardian reported Trump calling Bloomberg correspondent Catherine Lucey “piggy” after she questioned him about Epstein files.
reason: The Guardian's dated reports identify the reporter, exchange, and Epstein-questioning context.

sources.title: Trump calls New York Times reporter ‘ugly’ in latest insult to female journalist

reason: The Guardian and NBC News directly document the post, target, and context.

reason: The American Presidency Project preserves the post; TheWrap reports the same date and attack.
